metadata.description: Arcgram — surface an AI agent's reasoning as auditable data you can inspect and correct. Delivered as a single standalone HTML diagram for human↔AI collaboration, for any AI agent.

plugins.name: arcgram
plugins.description: Surface an AI agent's thinking and make it auditable. Instead of a wall of prose, your agent lays out its reasoning as typed nodes and explicit edges — real data you inspect and correct node by node. Use it as an agent harness or operating frame: propose → draw → self-audit → fix, human in the loop. Delivered as a single standalone interactive HTML file (no build step, no npm, no CDN, no runtime). Bundles the Arcgram authoring skill plus Checkpoint / Reconcile / Validate self-checks. Agent-neutral.
